goal: Redesign the Tarot card meaning screen (Học lá) to the approved TarotCard design canvas and fill it with the Owner-approved per-topic meanings, misconceptions, support notes and astrology correspondences for all 78 cards.
successCriteria: packages/content/data/tarot-card-guide.json holds, for all 78 card ids, VI/EN love/career/self meanings (upright), a misconception, optional otherReadings and supportNote, element, astrology, optional modernPlanet and note keys, built from docs/content-review drafts after the Owner decisions of 2026-10-30.
scripts/validate-data.mjs checks the guide covers exactly the 78 card ids with accented Vietnamese and English text in every field and that note keys resolve.

The card meaning screen shows, in order: library position n/78, card art (tap = full screen), arcana kicker, Vietnamese name, English name, element and astrology; an Upright/Reversed switch that defaults to the drawn orientation when opened from a reading and rotates the art; the selected orientation meaning; for upright, three topic cards (love, career, self); Hay bị hiểu nhầm; other readings and support notes when present; the reflection prompt as Thực hành; deeper lessons, archetype and Chat with this card kept; astrology notes; previous/next card.
No Nhìn kỹ bức tranh block and no bookmark button are shown, since that content and feature do not exist yet.
npm --workspace apps/mobile run check, the mobile Jest suite and npm run validate:data pass, and a 390x844 web check covers a major, a minor and a court card in both orientations.
untouchedSurfaces: tarot-cards.json, the Edge Functions, AI prompts and Admin seed are unchanged; the guide is app-only content.
Ask, draw and result stages are separate tasks in this slice.
Nhìn kỹ bức tranh (per-deck picture notes) and a bookmark feature are not built.
